title: Todd McFarlane's Spawn: The Video Game
description: Todd McFarlane's Spawn: The Video Game is a video game based on the Spawncomic book character. It was released in the United States and Europe for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System console. Developed by Ukiyotei and published by Acclaim Entertainment and Sony Electronic Publishingin late 1995, it features Al Simmons, Spawn, trying to save the lives of thirteen children in a beat 'em uptype of video game. The game received mixed reviews by critics; the graphics were praised while the unoriginality of the game was criticized.
